svg.title: RV32I-Subset Five-Stage Pipelined Processor: Architecture Datapath
svg.desc: Left-to-right datapath of a 32-bit RV32I-subset processor (ADD, SUB, AND, OR, ADDI, LW, SW, BEQ). PC and Instruction Memory feed IF/ID; Control Unit, Immediate Generator and Register File feed ID/EX; forwarding muxes, ALUSrc mux, ALU and BEQ logic feed EX/MEM; Data Memory feeds MEM/WB; the Writeback Mux drives the Register File write port. Dashed blue paths show EX/MEM forwarding (2'b10, priority) and MEM/WB forwarding (2'b01). Dashed red paths show the Hazard Unit, which detects only the load-use stall: it holds PC and IF/ID and flushes ID/EX for one bubble. Dashed orange paths show separate Pipeline Control logic driven by branch_taken: on a taken BEQ it redirects PC to id_ex_pc + id_ex_immediate and flushes IF/ID and ID/EX.

rdf:Description.dc:title: architecture.svg
rdf:Description.dc:description: Architecture datapath for an educational SystemVerilog RV32I-subset five-stage pipeline with forwarding, load-use stall and EX-stage BEQ resolution.

svg.text: RV32I-Subset Five-Stage Pipelined Processor: Architecture Datapath
ADD, SUB, AND, OR, ADDI, LW, SW, BEQ · EX/MEM and MEM/WB forwarding · one-bubble load-use stall · BEQ resolved in EX

g.text: writeback data + rd to Register File write port
1. Control bits from the Control Unit travel with ID/EX, EX/MEM and MEM/WB.
2. Forwarding Unit compares ID/EX rs1, rs2 against EX/MEM rd and MEM/WB rd.
Priority: EX/MEM (2'b10), then MEM/WB (2'b01), else register value (2'b00).
3. SW store data is the forwarded rs2 value, carried through EX/MEM.
4. Hazard Unit (load-use only): hold PC and IF/ID, flush ID/EX, one bubble.
Load data is never forwarded from EX/MEM; it exists only after MEM.
flush IF/ID and ID/EX. Not taken: PC + 4 continues.
